source_binding.label: PRIVATE_GLOBAL_CLOCK_AND_MATCHED_WORK_NOT_QUALIFICATION
source_binding.base_vs_production: Exact local calibration candidate plus identical separately bound private instrumentation. No qualification or readiness claim.
source_binding.history: Original full code then chat, each T0/T1 and all widths, one ordered diagnostic rotation. Complete original history, not qualification or a timing retry.

source_binding.retained_runtime_patch_scope: 2ac to local798; not an additional patch to798

private_diagnostic_limits.target_shape: Exact rows 0..32 only; calls_above32 explicitly counted; existing legacy bins clamp above32.
private_diagnostic_limits.counter_unrecorded_head_last: Route predicate only, not proof of frontend prefill versus queued decode.
private_diagnostic_limits.copy_float_encoding: decimal IEEE754 u64 bits; null retained for unknown.
private_diagnostic_limits.counter_perturbation: bounded samples/fences and encoder rotation; not performance qualification.
private_diagnostic_limits.command_gpu_ms: Raw command-buffer stopwatch; reject if invalid/outside calibrated CPU envelope before interpreting.
private_diagnostic_limits.class_gpu_ms: two-point calibrated GPU counter samples; unsupported/invalid fails.

source_binding.candidate_calibration_scope: Admitted residency and committed head/calibration buffers, before preparing tap destinations; no target math, dtype, trial, driver or oracle change.
source_binding.clock_sampler: gpu_power,thermal only; complete persistent checkpoints; original sampled phase retained

source_binding.target_counter_phase_labels: decode/prefill in old aggregate snapshots mean recorded/unrecorded, including queued decode; exact per-forward fields are separately named.
source_binding.clock_scope: Global GPU frequency association with exact original RPC phase windows; no occupancy, per-process GPU claim, qualification or performance override.

phase_sample_rule: Conservative interval [date-elapsed_ns,date+elapsed_ns+1second] covers either start-date or end-date semantics and one-second quantization. Entire interval must be inside RPC window, using the observed wall/perf offset range. No delayed receipt timestamp is treated as a sampling timestamp.
limitations: Global GPU clock/busy observations, not process attribution, SIMD occupancy or bandwidth. Raw frequency units preserved. Interior-only samples exclude boundaries and may be absent for short phases. No A/A control, confidence bound, qualification retry, timing clearance, power override or causal intervention.
